description: Traduction français → anglais : contacter, évaluer, l'évaluation, la hauteur sol, survoler, les installations de stockage, les entrepôts, l'infirmerie, l'établissement médical, personnes à bord, l'immatriculation, cap au sud, cap 180, sur le chemin du retour, suspect, l'officier responsable, commander, les pièces détachées, la défense sol-air, s'engager, l'opérateur télécom, le technicien télécom.

questions.question: contacter (expression en 4 mots)
questions.explication: *I'll **get in touch with** the embassy tomorrow.* — Plus simple : *contact somebody* (sans préposition).

questions.question: évaluer (commence par **a**)
questions.explication: *Experts came to **assess** the damage.*

questions.question: l'évaluation
questions.explication: *We need a full **assessment** of the situation.* — Orthographe : deux fois *ss* (*a-ss-e-ss-ment*).

questions.question: la hauteur sol (abréviation)
questions.explication: *The drone flew at 400 feet **AGL**.* — *AGL* = *Above Ground Level*.

questions.question: survoler
questions.explication: *Two jets **overflew** the city at noon.* — On dit aussi *fly over*. Irrégulier : *overfly – overflew – overflown*.

questions.question: les installations de stockage
questions.explication: *The fuel is kept in secure **storage facilities**.*

questions.question: les entrepôts
questions.explication: *The spare parts are stored in two **warehouses**.* — Orthographe : *ware* + *houses*.

questions.question: l'infirmerie
questions.explication: *The injured sailor was taken to the **sickbay**.*

questions.question: l'établissement médical
questions.explication: *The nearest **medical facility** is 20 km away.*

questions.question: personnes à bord (abréviation)
questions.explication: *Report fuel endurance and **POB** to the tower.* — *POB* = *Persons On Board*.

questions.question: l'immatriculation
questions.explication: *The witness wrote down the car's **registration number**.*

questions.question: cap au sud
questions.explication: *The convoy is moving **southbound** on the A7.*

questions.question: cap 180
questions.explication: *Turn left **heading 180** and climb to 5,000 feet.* — *heading* = cap ; à la radio, chiffres un par un : *one eight zero*.

questions.question: sur le chemin du retour
questions.explication: *The **homebound** soldiers were cheering on the ship.*

questions.question: suspect (adjectif)
questions.explication: *Report any **suspicious** activity to security.* — Le nom « un suspect » se dit *a suspect*.

questions.question: l'officier responsable (abréviation)
questions.explication: *Ask the **OIC** before leaving the area.* — *OIC* = *Officer In Charge*.

questions.question: commander (une unité)
questions.explication: *Who **is in command** here?* — Piège : « commander » au restaurant se dit *to order*.

questions.question: les pièces détachées
questions.explication: *The mechanics are waiting for **spare parts**.*

questions.question: la défense sol-air (abréviation)
questions.explication: ***GBAD** units protect the base against drones.* — *GBAD* = *Ground Based Air Defence*.

questions.question: s'engager (dans l'armée)
questions.explication: *He **joined up** at eighteen.*

questions.question: l'opérateur télécom
questions.explication: *The **telecom operator** handles all radio calls at night.*

questions.question: le technicien télécom
questions.explication: *A **telecom technician** came to fix the antenna.*
